witness.explanation: Distinct propagated residuals do not identify distinct locations: different Pauli faults at one CNOT location can produce different residuals. The proposed representative-by-representative construction therefore does not automatically yield a legal fault configuration.
witness.evidence: At a single ancilla-to-data CNOT a→q_j, the draft's own Proposition 1.13(4) lists possible residuals ∅, S_j, {q_j}, S_{j−1}. Here S_j is the subsequent data suffix and S_{j−1}=S_j⊕{q_j}. Choosing the ancilla-X and data-X faults for S_j and {q_j} selects the same physical location twice. Their product is one X⊗X fault of cost one with residual S_{j−1}, not two occupied locations. The formal effective basis vector [S_{j−1}] also need not equal [S_j]+[{q_j}]. This refutes the distinct-location inference; a repaired existence proof requires a collision argument.
